title: Ananya Panday, Kartik Aaryan's 'Fake Tan' Looks For Film Go Viral; Fans Call It 'Deepika-fication'
text:
Ananya Panday, Kartik Aaryan's 'Fake Tan' Looks For Film Go Viral; Fans Call It 'Deepika-fication'
Ananya Panday and Kartik Aaryan are being trolled for their looks in Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri.
Ananya Panday and Kartik Aaryan’s looks for Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri have surfaced on Reddit, and the reactions aren’t too positive. Ananya and Kartik have been in Croatia for a while now for the film’s shoot. The viral images show them in ‘tanned’ avatars. While Kartik’s hair is styled in what seems to be a mohawk, Ananya Panday can be seen with golden highlights.
Ananya Panday and Kartik Aaryan’s looks for the film are not sitting right with fans. The viral images from the film’s shoot showcase Ananya in a completely different avatar from her image featured in the film’s announcement photo. The actress appears to be tanned, and her voluminous hair has been coloured with golden and light brown highlights.
Recommended Stories
Although fans expect Kartik Aaryan to don new looks in his films, his recent avatar hasn’t impressed fans. Most of the actor’s hair has been cut short in a fade. His side profile gives the appearance of a mohawk. The rest of his hair is spiky at the top. Kartik also appears to be tanned in the photo.
It is unclear if the actors have gotten tanned for the roles or if the images were taken in bad lighting. In any case, fans aren’t too happy with the actors’ looks. One person wrote, “It is fake tan." Another added, “Kartik is giving Jethalal hairstyle energy 😭." Another commented, “Kartik Aaryan looks like a 50-year-old’s idea of what a youngster looks like 🤣."
One comment read, “The Deepikafication of Ananya." Another added, “First thought that came to my mind. She has tanned her skin colour 10x to look like DP. The hair colour, hairstyle, the make-up… they’ll try everything to make these nepo wannabes 1% palatable. It’s NOT WORKING." Another wrote, “Ananya Panday looks so Deepikafied." Someone else wrote, “Ananya Patani?"
Meanwhile, Ananya Panday has wrapped her schedule for Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri. Kartik Aaryan is yet to finish his schedule. With the shoot of Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri ongoing in Europe, fans are eagerly awaiting the film’s release next year.
